decisions.reason: This product is closely related to the firm's core pipeline component business and likely continues to meet existing customer needs.
As a public waste bin, this product is distant from the firm's water infrastructure core and likely lacks strategic fit and profitability.
This ashtray-equipped waste bin is also distant from the core business and probably fails to justify its resource use.
Outdoor public ashtrays are far from the firm's established offer and likely have limited demand, making discontinuation probable.
